name: pr393-cubic-fp8-model512-ngram2-projlr080
architecture: PR393 variant: residual width512, four128-dimensional attention heads, eight64-channel MUDD groups, ngram width512. All five top1-eight-expert MoE sites use1536 rank-one cubic KS3 charts; dense hidden width2816.
geometry_averaging: Replicated geometry follows original MoE tail-average and bank-blend ticks and rates; no geometry norm rescaling.
hypothesis: Increase only KS3 projection learning rate from 2/3 to 0.8 on the 512-residual,1536-chart recipe. The inherited compensation kept the original 768/1024 effective factor fixed; test whether the wider aspect-ratio experts benefit from a 20% stronger update while dense/head/table rates remain fixed.
memory_estimate: Adds10.83GB decimal (10.09GiB) per GPU to the BF16 sharded ngram table, plus~85MB row optimizer state. Prior512 peak26464MiB and reserved42626MiB leave room on80GB H100.
